note: Angola's largest banks are BAI, BFA and Banco BIC; BAI's price list for private customers (in force from 24 October 2025, still the one on its site) was read in full for its credit cards, and BFA's and BIC's weren't reached. BAI's Visa Classic, Visa Gold and MULTICAIXA credit cards: yearly fees of 32,600, 42,700 and 7,000 kwanzas (the same in the first and later years), issue fees of 5,175, 18,000 and 5,000, late payment charges of 19,500, 19,500 and 10,000, an over-limit charge of 16,000 on the Visa cards (none on the MULTICAIXA card), and fixed interest of 3.00% a month (2.5% on the MULTICAIXA card). 14% VAT is added to every fee and 0.2% stamp duty on interest, written as tax (this file wrote the Visa Classic's fee with its VAT, 37,164, before the form had a tax term; it is now the fee before VAT, with the VAT as tax). The list's worked examples of the cost of credit assume yearly fees (17,500 and 32,750) that differ from its fee table; the table is written. The Visa Platinum card (100,000 a year) gives no interest rate (N/A), so it isn't written. The renewal, replacement, cancellation and blocking charges, met only when a card is renewed or replaced on request, aren't written.
